avg_temp.name: Average temperature
avg_temp.definition: The average temperature across the whole year, day and night.

day_temp.name: Daytime highs
day_temp.definition: The average of each day's highest temperature across the year.

night_temp.name: Night-time lows
night_temp.definition: The average of each night's lowest temperature across the year.

rain_total.name: Rain
rain_total.definition: All the rain that fell in the year, added up.

sunshine.name: Sunshine
sunshine.definition: The average energy from the sun reaching the ground each day (records start in 1984).
